this is no longer just init for emmc.   In reality, its closer to init for ext4 block devices.

But I am ok keeping the name at this time.  It is a bit easier following the history without a recipe (files and directory) rename.
I also prefer to keep the name at this time.
Therre doesn't appear to be anying Aspeed Technology (ast) related.  This appears to just be ufs.
V8: Update to mf-ufs. Please review again. Thanks.

It now shows we are a bit scattered by placing the secondary gpt on a fixed drive name, then mounting the root from a kernel command line supplied partition label and the read write (var) from a hard coded partition label, with nothing tying to the same media technology.

But this is just observing technical debt for a future patch.  (I'm reviewing this with the work in progress on the stm32mp257f layer).
I'd prefer we not change this file extension here.  There are no other cases in meta-phosphor where we do this and by changing the extension you cause things like shellcheck to not run correctly.
